remarks:
Looking for a buildable lot in the Williamsville School District with room to plan your next home? This approximately 1.5-acre cleared vacant lot offers a rare chance to create the space you want in a convenient location.

The open lot gives you a clean starting point for your build, with space for a home, yard, outdoor living area, subject to approvals. The setting offers the feel of more room while still keeping you close to everyday needs and major routes.

Utilities are available at the road, except septic, which will be needed. 

Located in Williamsville Schools, this property offers easy access to Amherst, Niagara County, and I-990, making it a practical choice for commuting, errands, and future plans.
